description_en: You can call DescribeElasticDailyPlan to query the execution information of a daily time-based scaling plan. This operation applies only to new-version Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode
description_zh: 调用DescribeElasticDailyPlan接口查询分时弹性计划日计划执行信息。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
name: DescribeElasticDailyPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must be 2 to 30 characters in length.

It must consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。取值说明：
长度为2~30字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html to query the name of the resource group
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html接口查看资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The start date of the daily scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 当天弹性计划的起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_daily_plan_day

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the daily scaling plan. To query multiple statuses, separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

1: Not executed.

2: Executing.

3: Succeeded.

4: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
当天弹性计划执行状态，同时查询多个状态用半角逗号（,）分隔，取值说明：
1：未执行。
2：执行中。
3：执行成功。
4：执行失败。
parameters.name: elastic_daily_plan_status_list
